package.description: Personal library manager for PDFs using GitHub Release assets

en-US.description: Personal library manager for PDFs using GitHub Release assets
en-US.longDescription:
shelfctl is a personal library manager for organizing PDFs and books across
GitHub using Release assets instead of git commits. It provides a terminal UI
for browsing, caching, annotating, and syncing your library across devices.
en-US.name: shelfctl
